THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Oder under Section 39 A (1)

The allotments of land specified in the Order No. 112 of 1967 madeunder the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act(Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extra- Ordinary No. 14/744 dated 12th April 1967 is vested absolutely in the State and thePossession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the Stateunder Para (a) of Section 40 of the Aforesaid Act. But by the Virtueof powers vested in me by Sub Section (1) of Section 39 (a) (insertedby Act, No. of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act. I GayanthaKarunatilleke, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms dohereby divest only the allotment described in the Schedule below.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.

My Ref. No.: 03J/66-67/HA/129.Divisional Secretary's No. Divu/San/2/L/Ath/10/2002.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,No.1200/6, Rajamalwatta Avanue,Battaramulla.07th September, 2018.
